[[File:ImpulseDetectorSWG.png|thumb|right|250px|An impulse detector]]
'''Impulse detectors''', or impulse scanners, were small tools used as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] in a mechanic's kit to monitor the energy exhausted from a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer's]] engine. It included a signal clarifier, a receiver antenna, and a detector unit.

{{Tech-stub}}
